axes.behavior: Mutable native material configuration; fresh EnumMap/ArmorMaterial/direct Holder on vanilla(); direct native armor constructors and finite attribute handoff.
axes.costs: No mana, cast or cooldown operation in the material. Item durability is a configured maximum, not a proved wear/repair settlement or gameplay cost.
axes.identity: Publisher 1.0.10 SHA-1/SHA-256/size; class declarations and all ten ACArmorMaterial JVM methods, including both constructors and separate <clinit>.
axes.integration: Native constructor, registry, sound-holder and selected attribute bridge calls only; external engine internals, active armor effects and perks remain outside scope.
axes.parameters: Six literal registry declarations; MAX_DAMAGE_ARRAY [13,15,16,11]; ordinal-indexed defense/durability; raw array alias; captured repair supplier and five setup writes.
axes.targeting: Not applicable: configuration/armor construction has no target query, damage request, projectile or effect application; direct attribute consumers do not create a spell target.
axes.validation: Typed all-class reference census, declaration/body reconciliation, explicit operand/branch pivots, immutable artifact identity and deterministic seal reproduction; physical gameplay remains NOT_TESTED.

integration_bounds.array_alias: Long constructor stores caller int[] directly; no defensive copy or validation.
integration_bounds.durability: MAX_DAMAGE_ARRAY[type.ordinal()] * multiplier is JVM int multiplication, passed to supplied Item.Properties.durability; maximum configuration, no observed wear/repair settlement.
integration_bounds.excluded: Active armor powers and tick behavior beyond the finite dispatch/operand witness, Minecraft/NeoForge engine internals, external consumers, perks/hooks, network authorization, rendering, resource packs, datapack/runtime registry contents and physical gameplay.
integration_bounds.name: Stored by constructor; not read by vanilla(), which passes List.of() as material layers.
integration_bounds.native_bridge_ceiling: Six direct item constructors; Diving/Gingerbread finite attributes and ACCompat sound/attribute bridges. ArmorItem, Item.Properties, Ingredient, registries, attribute engine and accepted gameplay outcomes remain external.
integration_bounds.ordinal_limit: Only vanilla() skips ordinals >= damageReduction.length. properties() and defense() directly index arrays; null/short arrays or non-four-slot ordinals have no native guard.
integration_bounds.snapshot_and_live_state: vanilla() snapshots defense/enchantability/sound/toughness/knockback in fresh ArmorMaterial+Holder; supplier captures this and reads current ingredient. Later setRepairMaterial including null affects future supplier reads; constructor values and arrays are not perk APIs.

actual_tick_dispatch.boundary: Observed native method tests ACTickingItem; does not dispatch via ACArmorTickItem. Mixin application and gameplay outcomes are not tested.
actual_tick_dispatch.name: ac_inventoryTick

darkness_inventory_tick_boundary.limit: Only Player/worn-armor gates and helper invocation; active power and cloak suffix are excluded.
darkness_inventory_tick_boundary.name: acInventoryTick

marker.limit: No typed dispatcher/member/class reference beyond declaration and sole direct implementer in 1555 publisher class entries. Reflective name construction, external mods and future versions are not closed.

typed_reference_census.method: CLASS/Fieldref/Methodref/InterfaceMethodref/NameAndType/MethodType plus declared JVM descriptors; plain UTF8/String constants do not count

validation.authority: SHA-exact publisher binary; public adjacent source is not used for installed parameters.
validation.reproduction: Mandatory exact seal comparison; deterministic report, negative pivot/census/declaration tests and twice-run physical binary CLI idempotence.
